questions.prompt: Bundle core inserts llm, tools and loop. Bundle shell inserts bash. Your patch.yml disables bash. How many plugins mount?
options: 3, because your patch applies after the bundles and wins
1, because your patch replaces the whole list
0, because the profile starts from an empty list
questions.explanation: Layers apply in order over an empty list. The bundles make 4 rows, and your patch, applied later, disables bash, so 3 plugins mount.

questions.prompt: You change max_tokens in the llm row and save the file. What does a hot reload do?
options: Disposes every fiber and mounts all rows again
Disposes the llm fiber and mounts that row again; unchanged rows keep their fibers
Changes the value inside the running adapter without disposing anything
questions.explanation: The kernel compares rows by id and touches only the row that changed. The loop, which injects llm, waits and returns on its own.

questions.prompt: In dsh, why should every row carry an explicit id for hot reload?
options: A row without one gets a new id on each read, so every edit removes and adds it
Rows without an id are never mounted
The id decides which bundle the row belongs to
HMR reads only the first row of each file
questions.explanation: The loader compares rows by id. A generated id changes on every read, so the row looks removed and added and is remounted even when its lines did not change.
